blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Zero-shot whole-slide image (WSI) prediction aims to generalize to new pathology tasks without parameter updates at deployment. MI-Zero makes these predictions by pooling patch-text similarities. Conditional weight generation, combined with supervision from diverse pathology tasks, offers an alternative: learning to construct predictive rules from task descriptions. We introduce MI-Hyper, a hypernetwork pretrained across mixed tasks to generate the aggregation and classification weights of multiple instance learning (MIL) models. We first train the generator and a shared MIL basis jointly using source labels. We then freeze the basis and refine the generator. The generated task weights are reused across cases. Across 308 tasks from 52 pathology datasets, MI-Hyper improves mean AUC, balanced accuracy and macro-F1 over MI-Zero by 1.85, 1.17 and 0.57 percentage points, respectively. On some molecular prediction tasks, both AUC and balanced accuracy improve by more than 20 points. These results support task-conditioned weight generation as a promising approach to weight-space transfer for long-sequence modeling.

MI-Zero通过集合补丁文本的相似性来作出这些预测. 有条件的权重生成,加上来自不同病理任务的监督,提供了一个替代方案:学习从任务描述中构建预测规则. 我们引入了MI-Hyper,这是一个跨混合任务预先训练的超网络,生成多个实例学习模型的聚合和分类权重. 我们首先用源标签 来训练发电机和共享的MIL基础 然后,我们冻结基础 并完善发电机。 生成的任务权重在个案中重复使用。 在52个病理数据集的308个任务中,MI-Hyper改进了平均AUC,平衡精度和宏F1比MI-Zero分别提高了1.85分,1.17分和0.57分. 在一些分子预测任务上,AUC和平衡精度都提高了20多分. 这些结果支持以任务为条件的重量生成,作为长序列模型化的重量空间转移的一种有希望的方法.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Zero-shot whole-slide image (WSI) prediction seeks to reuse a trained system for new pathology tasks without task-specific optimization at deployment. Because the same slide can support subtyping, grading and molecular prediction, the relevant tissue evidence depends on the endpoint. A zero-shot predictor must therefore select and combine patterns across long patch sequences according to the task.
blocks.zh: 零镜头全滑影像(WSI)预测试图在部署时重用一个训练有素的系统来完成新的病理任务,而不进行特定任务优化. 由于同样的滑动可以支持子打字,分级和分子预测,相关的组织证据取决于终点. 因此,一个零射线预测器必须根据任务在长补丁序列中选择和组合模式.

blocks.en: Pathology foundation models provide a common starting point through reusable representations at the patch and whole-slide levels [ 30 , 11 ] . For patch-based prediction, multiple instance learning (MIL) converts a bag of representations into a slide-level output through aggregation and classification [ 18 , 32 ] . Aggregation and classification parameters determine how tissue features contribute to a particular endpoint. The remaining question is how to obtain these parameters for a new task without additional target-task optimization.
blocks.zh: 病理基础模型通过补丁和全滑层的可重复使用表述[30,11]提供了一个共同的起点. 对于基于补丁的预测,多实例学习(MIL)通过聚合和分类将一组表达式转换成幻灯片级输出[18,32]. 聚合和分类参数决定组织特征如何促进特定终点. 剩下的问题是如何在没有额外目标任务优化的情况下为新任务获得这些参数.

blocks.en: Language provides a natural interface for specifying tasks through class descriptions. MI-Zero uses this interface to compare patch and class-text representations in a shared embedding space, then pools their similarities into slide-level predictions [ 31 ] . Changing the descriptions changes the similarity scores, which a predefined operator pools. This language interface also suggests a complementary route: generating the parameters that govern MIL aggregation and classification from the descriptions.
blocks.zh: 语言提供了通过类描述来指定任务的自然界面. MI-Zero使用这个接口比较共享嵌入空间中的补丁和类文本表示,然后将它们的相似性集合到幻灯片级预测[31]. 更改描述会改变一个预定义的操作员集合的相似性分数 。 这种语言界面也建议了一个互补的路径:从描述中生成规范MIL聚合和分类的参数.

blocks.en: Conditional weight generation provides a mechanism for learning this mapping from descriptions to predictors. Hypernetworks generate model parameters from conditioning information, and language-conditioned methods extend this principle to classifiers and adaptation weights [ 14 , 2 , 6 ] . Meanwhile, labeled pathology datasets cover multiple organs and prediction endpoints [ 45 , 52 ] . These source labels can supervise predictions made by generated models, allowing the description-to-weight mapping to be learned across tasks. This provides a basis for studying transfer through the weights of generated MIL predictors.
blocks.zh: 有条件的权重生成提供了一个从描述到预测器学习这种映射的机制. 超网络从条件信息生成模型参数,语言条件方法将这一原则延伸至分类器和适应权重[14,2,6]. 同时,标注的病理数据集涵盖多个器官和预测终点[45,52]. 这些源标签可以监督生成模型作出的预测,使得描述到加权的映射能够跨任务学习. 这为研究通过生成的MIL预测器的权重进行转移提供了基础.

blocks.en: Building on this opportunity, we introduce MI-Hyper, a hypernetwork pretrained across mixed tasks to construct MIL predictors from task and class descriptions. Figure 1 contrasts MI-Zero’s similarity pooling with MI-Hyper’s weight generation, while Figure 2 presents the training and deployment framework. We first train the generator and a shared MIL basis through source-label prediction. With the basis fixed, we then refine the dual-text generator using source labels and text-consistency objectives. At deployment, MI-Hyper generates task-specific aggregation and classification weights for each text condition and reuses them across cases. The generated parameters are shared within a task, but attention is computed from each case’s tissue content. Their number is independent of bag length, so task-level model generation is separate from computation over each case’s complete patch sequence. This separation allows us to study weight-space transfer in long-sequence modeling.
blocks.zh: 在这个机会的基础上,我们引入了MI-Hyper,这是一个跨混合任务预先训练的超网络,从任务和类描述中构建MIL预测器. 图1对比了MI-Zero的相似性与MI-Hyper的重量生成,图2则介绍了培训和部署框架。 我们首先通过源标签预测来训练发电机和共享的MIL基础. 随着基础的固定,我们然后利用源标签和文本一致性目标来完善双文本生成器. 在部署时,MI-Hyper为每个文本条件生成任务特定汇总和分类权重,并跨例重复使用. 所生成的参数是在一项任务中共享的,但注意力是根据每个病例的组织内容计算的。 它们的编号独立于包长,因此任务级模型生成与每个案例的完整补丁序列的计算是分开的. 这种分离使我们能够在长序模型学中研究权重空间转移.

blocks.en: We train MI-Hyper with five folds over 112 semantic groups and compare it with MI-Zero on 308 tasks from 52 pathology datasets. Target task IDs are held out from source optimization and checkpoint selection, while cases can recur across tasks. On the complete query set, MI-Hyper improves mean AUC, balanced accuracy and macro-F1 by 1.85, 1.17 and 0.57 percentage points, respectively. On some molecular prediction tasks, both AUC and balanced accuracy improve by more than 20 points. To understand these results, we organize performance by endpoint, anatomy, bag size and dataset source, then examine individual tasks and the relation between generated queries and spatial attention.
blocks.zh: 我们训练MI-Hyper,有5个折叠的112个语义组,并与MI-Zero比较来自52个病理数据集的308项任务. 从源头优化和检查点选择中保留目标任务ID,而案件可以跨任务重复出现。 在完整的查询集上,MI-Hyper将AUC,均衡精度和宏F1分别提高1.85,1.17和0.57个百分点. 在一些分子预测任务上,AUC和平衡精度都提高了20多点. 为了了解这些结果,我们按端点,解剖学,包大小和数据集源来组织性能,然后检查单个任务以及生成的查询和空间关注之间的关系.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: ∙ \bullet We introduce MI-Hyper, which learns to generate task-specific MIL aggregation and classification weights from descriptions, separating predictor construction from case-level sequence processing. ∙ \bullet We train the generator on labels from mixed source tasks through joint learning and fixed-basis refinement. The generated parameters are reused across cases, while chunked execution processes each complete patch sequence. ∙ \bullet We evaluate this framework on 308 tasks from 52 pathology datasets, combining overall and task-level comparisons with analyses of generated queries and spatial attention.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三:\bullet 我们引入了MI-Hyper,它学习生成任务特定的MIL汇总和分类权重与描述,将预测器构造与案例级序列处理区分开来. * 弹夹 我们通过联合学习和固定基础的完善,从混合来源任务中培训发电机的标签。 生成的参数在个案中重复使用,而块化的执行过程则每个完整的补丁序列. * 弹夹 我们从52个病理学数据集对308项任务评价这一框架,将总体和任务一级的比较与对产生的查询和空间关注的分析结合起来。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: WSI analysis spans cancer detection and molecular prediction, with reliable evaluation depending on accurate reference labels [ 5 , 10 , 22 , 26 ] . Large-scale self-supervision, exemplified by UNI and Virchow, and contrastive learning produce reusable patch representations [ 8 , 39 , 42 , 41 , 53 ] . Representation learning also encompasses cell-level morphology [ 9 ] , global slide context [ 7 , 43 , 44 ] and multimodal learning from reports or molecular measurements [ 11 , 36 , 47 ] . To obtain slide predictions from patch features, ABMIL uses attention, CLAM uses clustering-constrained attention, and TransMIL models correlations among instances [ 18 , 32 , 38 ] . Related variants incorporate dual streams, agent tokens, graph interactions and distillation [ 24 , 27 , 13 , 25 , 48 ] . Conventional task-supervised MIL fits aggregation and classification parameters to each downstream task. MI-Hyper instead generates these parameters from task descriptions.
blocks.zh: WSI分析跨越癌症检测和分子预测,可靠评价取决于准确的参考标签[5,10,22,26]. 以UNI和Virchow为例的大规模自我监督以及对比性学习产生可重复使用的补丁表示[8,39,42,41,53]. 代表性学习还包括细胞一级形态学[9],全球幻灯片背景[7,43,44]和从报告或分子测量中学习的多式联运[11,36,47]. 为了从补丁特性中获取幻灯片预测,ABMIL使用注意,CLAM使用集群限制注意,跨MIL模型在实例间的相关性[18,32,38]. 相关变体包含双流,剂符,图相互作用和蒸馏[24,27,13,25,48]. 常规任务监督的MIL符合下游每项任务的汇总和分类参数. MI-Hyper转而从任务描述中生成这些参数.

blocks.en: Visual–semantic and contrastive learning align images with textual descriptions [ 35 , 34 ] . Learnable and image-conditioned prompts further adapt language-guided prediction to general visual recognition [ 51 , 50 ] . In biomedicine, pathology-specific models such as CONCH and broader biomedical models learn image–text alignment from paired data [ 17 , 30 , 20 , 49 ] . At the slide level, reports and clinical dialogue provide language supervision for attention and representation learning [ 37 , 11 , 40 ] . For zero-shot WSI prediction, MI-Zero pools similarities between patches and text [ 31 ] . Our MI-Zero implementation uses the same frozen image and text encoders as MI-Hyper. It applies CONCH-Z’s contrastive visual projection before pooling patch–text similarities, whereas MI-Hyper uses the patch features for MIL prediction.
blocks.zh: 视觉-语义和对比性学习使图像与文字描述一致[35,34]. 可学习和有图像条件的提示进一步使语言指导的预测适应一般视觉识别[51,50]. 在生物医学中,CONCH和更广泛的生物医学模型等病理学特异性模型从配对数据中学习图像——文本对齐[17,30,20,49]. 在幻灯片一级,报告和临床对话为注意和表现学习提供语言监督[37、11、40]。 对于零镜头的WSI预测,MI-Zero集合在补丁和文本上的相似性[31]. 我们的MI-Zero执行使用与MI-Hyper相同的冷冻图像和文本编码器. 它在集合补丁 - 文本相似性之前应用CONCH-Z的对比视觉投影,而MI-Hyper则使用补丁特性进行MIL预测.

blocks.en: Early zero-shot recognition methods predicted classifiers and convolutional filters from text [ 12 , 3 ] . More generally, hypernetworks generate model parameters from conditioning information [ 14 , 4 ] . This mechanism generates adapters and prompts [ 21 , 15 ] , supports instruction conditioning [ 19 ] , and can produce low-rank adaptation weights based on LoRA [ 16 , 6 ] . Language can also guide adaptation in a hypernetwork’s latent space [ 33 ] or determine an image encoder’s normalization parameters [ 1 ] . Set representations encode unordered class descriptions [ 46 , 23 ] , while permutation-equivariant prediction preserves their correspondence with class outputs [ 2 ] . MI-Hyper studies this description-to-weight mapping for MIL predictors operating on long WSI patch sequences.
blocks.zh: 早期的零射识别方法预言了从文本[12,3]中分解的分类器和演化过滤器. 更一般地说,超网络通过条件信息生成模型参数[14,4]. 这种机制生成适配器并提示[21,15],支持指令配置[19],并且可以基于LORA[16,6]产生低级适配重量. 语言还可以在超网络的潜在空间中引导适应 [33] 或确定图像编码器的正常化参数 [1]. 设置表达式编码无序类描述 [46, 23] ,而表征-等价预测则保留其与类输出的对应性 [2]. MI-Hyper为在长WSI补丁序列上运行的MIL预测器研究这种描述-加权映射.

blocks.en: The dual-text generator extends the class-name branch with a joint class-name–morphology branch. This branch has a separate trainable text adapter for morphology descriptions and a fusion adapter that combines each class’s name and morphology representations. An availability mask excludes missing or unverified morphology descriptions before class summarization and nonlinear interaction. A text-conditioned gate then linearly interpolates the queries, classifier rows and biases of the two branches, component by component. The gate receives task and class text representations, pairwise similarity statistics within and between the name and morphology embeddings, and morphology availability. It does not receive patch features from the query case. Text therefore determines the task weights before case features enter MIL prediction.

blocks.en: At deployment, the generator and shared basis remain fixed. blocks.en: Training details. We train five MI-Hyper models under the 112-group partition, using the SOURCE-FIT, SOURCE-DEV and target roles defined in Methods. We optimize parameters on SOURCE-FIT training cases and select checkpoints by task-average AUC on SOURCE-DEV validation cases. Both stages run for 15 epochs with the optimizer and patch-sampling settings in Methods.
blocks.zh: 培训详情。 我们在112组分区下培训5个MI-Hyper型号,使用UNURCE-FIT,UNURCE-DEV以及方法确定的目标角色. 我们优化资源资源中心-信息技术培训案例的参数,并通过平均任务量的哥伦比亚联合自卫军对资源资源资源中心-国防部队鉴定案例选定检查站。 两个阶段共运行15个纪元,在方法中都有优化器和补丁样本设置.

blocks.en: Evaluation protocols. We evaluate text-conditioned MIL model construction on 308 dataset–endpoint tasks from 52 pathology datasets. The common query set contains 160,989 task–bag records and 896 task-specific classes. Because a case may support several endpoints, these records do not represent mutually independent WSIs or patients. Bags contain 10–145,183 stored patches, with a median of 1,866, and all tasks contribute to the overall statistics. Supplementary Fig. S1 summarizes endpoint, anatomical and dataset coverage. Because mutation and staging tasks account for a large share of the collection, we report group-level results alongside the overall averages to distinguish coverage from performance within each group.
blocks.zh: 评估协议。 我们从52个病理学数据集评估308个数据集的文本条件的MIL模型构建。 常见的查询集包含160,989个任务-bag记录和896个任务特定类别. 由于病例可能支持几个终点,这些记录并不代表相互独立的WSI或病人. 袋装有10–145,183个存储的补丁,中间值为1,866,所有任务都有助于总体统计. 补充图S1概述了终点、解剖和数据集的覆盖范围。 由于突变和中转任务在收集工作中占很大份额,我们报告分组一级的成果,并报告总体平均数,以区分每个分组内的覆盖面和业绩。

blocks.en: For each task, we evaluate its original target-fold checkpoint against MI-Zero on the same query records, using all stored patches and keeping the generator and MIL basis fixed. Seven predefined pairs of text descriptions are used for each task, with a predictor generated and evaluated separately for each condition. Although target task IDs are held out, cases can recur in other source tasks. Matching patient identifiers or feature files across tasks identifies 100,573 query records in the eligible SOURCE-FIT pool and 4,873 in SOURCE-DEV; 55,543 have no recorded match. Pool membership does not establish that every case was sampled during optimization, and an unmatched record does not rule out unrecorded exposure. The evaluation therefore measures transfer to held-out task IDs across the complete query set, rather than generalization to an entirely unseen patient population.

Within each task, we average the 21 pairwise cosine similarities among its seven condition-specific queries, yielding a task-average value of 0.992. blocks.en: We next relate query differences to attention differences on the same patch sets across 18 WSIs from six TCGA datasets (Fig. 3 b). Query distance is the Euclidean distance divided by the mean query norm, d ⁡ ( q , r ) = 2 ​ ∥ q − r ∥ 2 / ( ∥ q ∥ 2 + ∥ r ∥ 2 ) d(q,r)=2\lVert q-r\rVert_{2}/(\lVert q\rVert_{2}+\lVert r\rVert_{2}) . Attention differences use base-2 Jensen–Shannon (JS) divergence. For each WSI, we average 49 cross-task or 21 within-task condition pairs, then average across three slides for each task or task pair. Spearman correlations across task-pair means and task means are 0.959 and 0.940, respectively. In these cases, query distance is positively associated with attention divergence.

blocks.en: Pooling depends on query direction and magnitude, but cosine similarity captures only direction. Positive rescaling can therefore change attention concentration without changing query direction. For two patches in the same bag, Eq. ( 5 ) gives log ⁡ ( α i / α j ) = q τ ⊤ ​ ( g i − g j ) \log(\alpha_{i}/\alpha_{j})=q_{\tau}^{\top}(g_{i}-g_{j}) . Consequently, a query change can alter relative patch weights through its projection onto the patch-feature difference, even when query directions remain close. Figure 3 b therefore compares generated queries with the attention distributions they induce on fixed patch sets.
blocks.zh: 集合取决于查询方向和大小,但余弦相似性只捕捉方向. 因此,正缩放可以改变注意力的集中,而不改变查询方向. 对于同一包中的两个补丁,Eq. (5)给出log QQ (α i / α j ) = q τ (g i - g j )\log(\alpha_{i /\alpha_{j }) = q_{\tau}^{\top }(g_{i ) - g_{j ). 因此,即使查询方向仍然接近,查询变化也可以通过对补丁的投影改变相对补丁重量。 因此,图3b将生成的查询与它们在固定补丁集中诱导的注意力分布进行比较。

blocks.en: On each COAD WSI, histological diagnosis and ATRX mutation prediction use the same patches, generator and shared MIL basis (Fig. 3 c). The difference in relative tissue weights therefore arises from the generated task query. Supplementary Fig. S3 shows 16 distinct tasks and WSIs from six TCGA datasets, covering grading, molecular subtyping and mutation prediction. Unlike the COAD comparisons, each supplementary panel uses a different task and WSI.

blocks.en: 4.3 Query–Classifier Recombination
blocks.zh: 4.3 查询 - 分类器重组

blocks.en: Having related generated queries to spatial attention, we next examine how the query and classifier affect case-level ranking. We exchange their sources across four tasks: ARID1A and TP53 prediction in BLCA and UCEC (Fig. 4 ). All combinations use the same frozen MIL basis and target-case features. Classifier rows are aligned by wildtype and mutant labels before exchange. We evaluate 891 cases and average metrics over seven separately evaluated text conditions.
blocks.zh: 在对空间注意力进行相关查询之后,我们接下来将审查查询和分类器如何影响案例级别排名。 我们交流了四个任务的来源:在BLCA和UCEC(图4)中,ARID1A和TP53预测。 所有组合都使用相同的冷冻MIL基和靶箱特性. 分类符行在交换前由野型和变种标签对齐. 我们评价891个案例和7个单独评价的文本条件的平均衡量标准。

blocks.en: For each target, we first keep its original classifier fixed and compare the AUC obtained with queries from all four tasks. The difference between the highest and lowest AUC averages 0.19 percentage points over the four targets. We then keep its original query fixed and exchange classifier weights and biases. This gives an average AUC range of 5.13 percentage points. Therefore, ranking performance is more sensitive to classifier source than to query source in these tasks.
blocks.zh: 对于每个目标,我们首先保持其原有的分类器固定,并将从所有四项任务中获得的AUC与查询进行比较. 最高和最低的哥伦比亚联合自卫军之间的差别平均为0.19个百分点。 然后,我们保持原有的查询 固定和交换分类器 加权和偏差。 这表明哥伦比亚联合自卫军的平均射程为5.13个百分点。 因此,排序性能对分类源比对这些任务中的查询源更敏感.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Through mixed-task source training, MI-Hyper learns to generate the aggregation and classification weights of MIL predictors from pathology task descriptions. Across 308 tasks from 52 pathology datasets, its mean AUC and balanced accuracy exceed those of MI-Zero, with substantial concurrent gains on some endpoints. These findings provide experimental support for constructing WSI predictors from task descriptions. Generating one predictor per text condition and reusing it across cases offers a promising route to weight-space transfer for long visual sequences.
blocks.zh: 通过混合任务源培训,MI-Hyper学习从病理学任务描述中生成MIL预测器的汇总和分类权重. 在来自52个病理数据集的308项任务中,其平均AUC和均衡的准确性超过了MI-Zero,在某些终点上也取得了很大的同时成果。 这些结论为从任务描述中构建WSI预测器提供了实验支持. 每个文本条件生成一个预测器并跨例重用,为长视序列的重量空间转移提供了一个有希望的路径.

blocks.en: Future work should broaden source-task coverage and investigate data augmentation. More stable weight generation will also be important for reliable prediction.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作应扩大源任务范围,并调查数据扩充情况。 更稳定的重量产生对于可靠的预测也很重要。
